body:
**FlowRanks** is a client-side Fabric mod for the FlowPvP server that brings your ranking data directly into Minecraft. See every player's ELO and rank icon in the tab list and above their heads, browse full leaderboards for all 9 gamemodes, and dive into any player's stats including their ELO history and recent matches. A customizable HUD lets you pin your current gamemode, your ELO, and your opponent's ELO anywhere on screen during matches.

**Features**
- ELO and rank icons in the tab list next to every player's name
- Rank display above player name tags in the world
- Leaderboards for all 9 gamemodes (Sword, Axe, UHC, Vanilla, Mace, Pot, NethOP, SMP, DiamondSMP)

- Skin previews and cached avatars

**Keybinds**
- G — Open leaderboard
- Y — Cycle gamemode
- O — Toggle name tags
- H — Open HUD editor
